$comment: Machine translation with Google Cloud Translation (ADR 0037). To add a locale, add one entry to targets and a matching column to glossary.csv, then run `pnpm --filter @xos/i18n translate --locale <code>`. Paths are relative to the repository root.

pricing.checked: 2026-10-20: Translation LLM, USD 10 per million input characters and 10 per million output characters (NMT: 20 per million, first 500,000 a month free). https://cloud.google.com/translate/pricing
